The position is suitable for part-time work and initially limited till 31rd December 2029. The GWDG strives for long-term cooperation. If interested, there is the possibility of a doctorate.The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing center for the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society. The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the University of Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG operates the HLRN-IV system “Emmy”, one of the most powerful computers in the world.As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG offers technical support to researchers and students from various science domains using sophisticated computer codes, including earth system science, life science, and engineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. At the same time, we aim to improve our close collaboration with the German Aerospace Center (DLR), and specialized computing centers including the German Climate Computing Center (DKRZ) and the Institute for Advanced Simulation Jülich (IAS-JSC).As part of our AI Service Center for Sensitive and Critical Infrastructure (KISSKI) we have created a number of AI-based services that offer high levels of security and privacy due to being processed on our own hardware. The position will be located within the subproject “KISSKI-EvoKS” and closely collaborate with customers from SMEs and Startups to develop prototypes and workflows that lead to PoCs and Blueprints. Those customers will come predominantly from sectors with high data protection requirements.The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science (CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with an opportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing, AI, and Machine Learning.ResponsibilitiesWe have a wide range of potential responsibilities that we would like to discuss with you. development of AI services- Generating blueprints and whitepapers- Document solutions for internal knowledge sharing and customer handover- Representation at workshops and conferences- Integration of novel AI solutions into our AI service portfolio- Integration of novel AI solutions into the SAIA Platform (Scalable Artificial Intelligence (AI) Accelerator)Requirements- Successfully completed master's degree in computer science or related fields- Very good programming skills in a high-level programming language, primarily Python- Very good Linux skills (e.g. Bash scripting, Git, containers)- Good knowledge of software engineering (security, testing)- Good knowledge of DevOps (e.g. Gitlab, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, pytest)- Good knowledge of databases (SQLModel, SQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite)- Experience with web development (HTTP, FastAPI, HTML, JavaScript)- Basics in generative AI (e.g. LLMs, diffusion models, and use with Pytorch or Tensorflow)- Excellent analytical skills- Excellent problem-solving skills- Very good German skills (C1)- Very good English skills (C1)- Willingness to travel on businessDesirable- Ability to communicate technical concepts to scientific computing, or data-intensive domains- Experience with the use of HPC systems (e.g. SLURM)Our offer- Flexible working hours and opportunity for mobile working- A modern, diverse, and jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the Test Means Component GR Team, Airbus is looking for aSoftware Developer for Lab Test Means (d/f/m)Within the Test Means & Digital platform domain, the 'Test Means Components' sub-department verifies and supports all instrumentation and test environments for laboratory, respectively ground test installations across all aircraft programs.You will integrate into the new and motivated Test Means Components team (across the Hamburg and Bremen sites) and serve as the Software Developer for Lab Test Means (d/f/m), taking full responsibility for ground test means components. In this role, you will be in charge of ensuring operational availability, driving new developments, and executing lifecycle governance of test means components while strictly complying with relevant quality standards and development processes. The main focus will be on Software Development according to German needs, e.g. test bricks for Ground Test Automation (GTA), Test Management System (TMS) and the Data Access Management System (DAMS):GTA: This software enables automated and remote testing. As Software Developer (d/f/m), you are responsible for developing and adapting local GTA bridges according to different test requirements based on the core GTA brick.TMS: The software drives the instrumentation, distributes parameters around between all necessary computers, executes simulation models, transmitting information between each.DAMS: This software tool records all test data from a test bench and uploads it to an archive.You will work closely with your transnational peers to foster best practices and lessons learned for a harmonized global approach. With a focus on software, you will take over responsibility for existing applications, including their registration and maintenance in ATOM (database).If you have strong experience in test instrumentation and software development, a passion for product ownership, and the motivation to manage end-to-end testing solutions in an operational aerospace environment, this job is for you!Your locationYou will be working across the Hamburg and Bremen sites.You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. jobs.description: Technical Application Scientist (m/f/d) – Sequencing (with English and Italian or French language skills)Work ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.Life Sciences Solutions supports customers with a wide range of products, services, and digital solutions across genetic testing, genomic analysis, proteomics, cell biology, precision medicine, and drug discovery. Our technologies are also applied in human identification, forensics, and advanced therapies such as CAR-T cell therapy, enabling scientific breakthroughs and improving global health.The Genetic Sciences teams are at the forefront of genomic discoveries, enabling innovation through advanced genetic analysis technologies, workflows, and services across cancer research, molecular diagnostics, human identification, agrigenomics, and more.Technical Application Scientist (m/f/d) – Sequencing (with English and Italian or French language skills)Location: DarmstadtDiscover Impactful WorkAre you passionate about making a difference within the Life Science segment and looking for a role that combines science, training, troubleshooting, and close customer interaction? Join us at Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Technical Application Specialist, where you'll provide expert technical support.A Day in the Life:In this role, you'll engage with researchers and clinicians, helping them advance critical work in areas like cancer research, diagnostics, and environmental protection. As part of an international team, you'll collaborate to solve complex scientific challenges. Your scientific expertise and customer service skills will help our customers make breakthrough discoveries while ensuring their optimal use of our innovative technologies. This role offers extensive training, professional development opportunities, and the chance to stay at the forefront of scientific advancement.What to expect:- Respond to customer emails and phone calls, providing technical support and guidance- Coordinate with other teams to resolve complex customer inquiries- Manage customer complaints through investigation, resolution, and follow-up- Ensure CRM records and processes comply with applicable requirements- Contribute to continuous improvement projects- Support the team’s day-to-day operational activitiesKeys to Success:Education- Master Degree in Biology, Biotechnology or other scientific subjects  with minimum 2 years of hands-on laboratory experience in Sequencing technology, Capillary Electrophoresis and/or NGS. qPCR, Microarray and human identification HID experience is a plusExperience- Minimum 2 years of hands-on laboratory experience in Sequencing technology, Capillary Electrophoresis and/or NGS. qPCR, Microarray and human identification HID experience is a plusKnowledge, Skills, Abilities- Excellent verbal and written communication skills for technical support delivery- Proven ability to quickly learn complex scientific/technical information- Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities- Fluent English and Italian or French required. Additional language skills highly valued- Customer service mindset with ability to explain complex concepts clearly- Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment- May require up to 10% travel for training• Flexibility to support global customer baseBenefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.employer_name: DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH
jobs.description: About the roleJoin us as our Team Lead Technical Operations and help shape the reliability, resilience, and future of DIGITEC’s SaaS operations!DIGITEC is a leading provider of Foreign Exchange SaaS solutions, specializing in FX Swaps, NDFs, and Money Markets. We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Team Lead Technical Operations to lead our TechOps team and ensure the reliable, secure, resilient, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms .In this role, you will combine technical leadership, people development, and operational ownership, leading a multinational TechOps team of four people based across Hamburg, London, and Singapore. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will play a key role in evolving our operations from manual and infrastructure-centric processes toward a more automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native environment, applying SRE and Operational Excellence principles.You will work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to continuously improve how we operate our platforms and deliver reliable services to our clients.Your ResponsibilitiesTechnical Operations & Reliability• Lead the reliable, resilient, secure, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms.• Drive service reliability using SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, and reliability engineering.• Oversee incident, problem, and escalation management while strengthening Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and technical resilience.Operational Excellence & Transformation• Drive the evolution toward automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native operations.• Continuously improve operational processes, tooling, automation, and KPIs to increase reliability and efficiency.• Promote a culture of Operational Excellence, continuous improvement, and effective problem management.Team Leadership & Collaboration• Lead and develop our multinational TechOps team across Hamburg, London, and Singapore, fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.• Provide technical and operational direction while remaining hands-on where needed.• Work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to align priorities, solve operational challenges, and continuously improve our services.Preferred qualifications• Several years of experience operating business-critical SaaS and cloud applications, combined with proven leadership experience in technical teams.• Strong hands-on experience with SRE and Operational Excellence, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, automation, operational KPIs, and continuous improvement.• Solid experience with incident, problem, and escalation management in production environments.• Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, networking, operating systems, and containerization.• Good knowledge of Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, technical resilience, and security principles relevant to SaaS operations.• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.• A hands-on and proactive mindset, with the willingness to understand the technical details of our D3 product family.• Fluent English skills.Nice to have Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:• ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.• Experience with AIOps, operational automation, or cloud-native transformation.• Experience working in regulated environments, ideally financial services.• German language skills.What we offer as an employer• Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.• Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.• Be part of an international work force: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.• Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.• Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.• Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.Our commitment to inclusion:We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders and identities, and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive teamAbout usDIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH stands at the forefront of the financial technology sector, renowned for developing cutting-edge software solutions. Our innovative products encompass a wide spectrum, from pricing and settlement solutions for FX/MM businesses to FX market data services. With over 40 prominent banks worldwide, spanning Europe, America, Asia, and Australia, among our esteemed clientele, we have solidified our position as a global leader.At the heart of our success is our exceptional team, comprised of approximately 80 dedicated professionals boasting expertise in software development, financial mathematics, sales, IT systems, and more. Operating from three key locations—Hamburg (headquarters), London, and Singapore—we champion equal opportunities and foster a culture of respect and collaboration, ensuring a welcoming and supportive work environment for all.Join us as we continue to redefine the landscape of financial technology with DIGITEC.
